name: Requirement

title: 'Requirement: '
labels: type:requirement, status:todo

---

Description
A short explanation of the requirement and why it is needed.

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC 1 — example: The system shows the item in the catalog when added.
- [ ] AC 2 — example: Metadata fields (title, author, ISBN) are validated.
- [ ] AC 3 — example: Unit tests cover the main behavior.

(Optional) Sub-tasks / Implementation checklist
- [ ] Design / spec (link if needed)
- [ ] Implement code
- [ ] Add tests
- [ ] Update docs (docs/ or README)
- [ ] Create PR that references this issue (use "Closes #<issue-number>")

Priority: medium
Estimate: 1 day (optional)

Related files / links
- Link to docs, designs, or related issues

Definition of done
- All acceptance criteria met
- Tests added and passing
- Documentation updated
- PR merged with "Closes #<issue-number>"

Notes
- Any extra details, constraints, or cross-team info.
